mapper.select: SELECT ur.role_name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_name = ur.role_name AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.locked = FALSE WHERE ur.role_name = #{roleName} AND ur.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_name = ur.role_name AND rp.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.locked = FALSE AND (p.permission_key = #{permissionKey} OR p.permission_key = '*') ORDER BY u.id
